clue.text: Low, immoral of French extraction, naturally!

parts.note: de is the French word for of
natural extraction, descent by birth from one's forebears, is generation, as in a family line

explanation.surface: A sneering remark about someone base and dissolute who naturally happens to be of French descent.
explanation.definitionFit: Moral decline leaves a person base and corrupt, so the state of having sunk low is this kind of decay.

clue.text: Imprisonment as result of trip around an ancient city

indicators.note: the dance word goes around the city name, so one piece wraps the other

parts.note: to trip is to dance lightly, as in trip the light fantastic
Ur was an ancient city of Mesopotamia

explanation.surface: Someone ends up jailed after a journey to see ancient ruins.
explanation.definitionFit: Durance is an old literary word for confinement, as in durance vile.

clue.text: Information about small lake in a ravine

indicators.note: the information word is placed about the lake abbreviation, enclosing it

parts.note: gen is British slang for information
L is the standard abbreviation for lake, as on maps

explanation.surface: A guidebook entry about a little lake lying in a gorge.
explanation.walkthrough: GEN is informal British English for information.
explanation.definitionFit: A glen is a narrow Scottish valley, much like a steep-sided gully.

clue.text: The celebrity turning up on schedule

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up means the little word on is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a timetable or table is a schedule

explanation.surface: A famous person arrives exactly when planned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning up' reverses ON to NO in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A well-known person may be called a notable, a synonym for a famous figure.

clue.text: Tell of cure, not disorder

indicators.note: disorder tells us the letters of cure and not are thrown into a jumble

explanation.surface: A medical saying that a remedy is not the same as an illness.
explanation.definitionFit: To narrate or relate a story is to recount it.

clue.text: Highly improbable!

parts.note: a word for high things that also describes a far-fetched yarn, as in the phrase about a story

explanation.surface: An exclamation of disbelief.
explanation.walkthrough: A tall story is one hard to believe; the answer also means high.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall tale is an exaggerated, unlikely story, and lofty things are high.

clue.text: Take an inordinate amount of time for jogging?

definitions.text: Take an inordinate amount of time
definitions.meaning: to go on beyond the allotted time, as a meeting can
a playful sense: running too much, excessive running

explanation.surface: A clue about a runner who goes on far too long.
explanation.definitionFit: A meeting that exceeds its slot does this, and the word split also suggests excessive running.

clue.text: Perfection demanded of the pastry cook

definitions.meaning: complete neatness and tidiness, the idiom for everything in its place
a playful reading: the arrangement a baker of tarts should keep

explanation.surface: The exacting standards required of a baker.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means perfect neatness, and literally suggests the arrangement of a baked tart.

clue.text: Cattle market? Well, one might find a bull there!

definitions.meaning: a playful reading: a place where livestock is traded

definitions.text: one might find a bull there
definitions.meaning: a bull is a trader expecting share prices to rise

explanation.surface: Musing on where bulls are bought and sold.
explanation.walkthrough: In finance a bull is an investor betting on rising prices.
explanation.definitionFit: The market where shares are traded has bulls and bears, and stock also means livestock.

clue.text: Mislead retiring minister in bold fashion

indicators.note: the reversed clergyman title is placed in the bold word

parts.note: pert means cheeky or bold

indicators.note: retiring means going backwards, so the clergyman's title is read in reverse

parts.note: Rev, short for Reverend, is a title for a minister

explanation.surface: A shy clergyman misleads people in a brazen way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retiring' looks like a description of a shy clergyman, but it signals reading his title backwards; 'in' then places the result inside the bold word.
explanation.definitionFit: To pervert is to lead astray or corrupt, so it can mean to misguide.

clue.text: Assemble for prayer

definitions.meaning: to gather together, as a verb
a short prayer used in church services

explanation.surface: Gathering people together to pray.
explanation.definitionFit: To gather things is to accumulate them, and a short liturgical prayer is also called by this word.

clue.text: Sustained hunger

explanation.surface: Describing an ongoing hunger.
explanation.definitionFit: Something extended lasts a lengthy while, and to yearn for something is to crave it.

clue.text: A period of ill-health can be concerning

parts.note: a bout is a spell of illness, as in a bout of flu

explanation.surface: Being unwell for a while can be worrying.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean on the subject of, as prepositions.

clue.text: A man in an almost hysterical state

indicators.note: the letters sit in the middle of the next word, almost all of it removed around them

explanation.surface: A man who is close to hysteria.
explanation.definitionFit: Eric is a common male first name.

clue.text: Records tips

definitions.meaning: to lean over, as a ship does

explanation.surface: Advice noted down.
explanation.definitionFit: Inventories or rolls are catalogues, and a ship that leans to one side heels.

clue.text: Fuel containing phosphorous and resin

indicators.note: the fuel word holds the chemical symbol inside it

parts.note: coal is a fuel
P is the chemical symbol for phosphorus

explanation.surface: Fuel mixed with a chemical and a sticky substance.
explanation.definitionFit: Copal is a hard tree gum used in varnishes.

clue.text: Take charge before the division!

parts.note: pre is a prefix meaning before
a side is a faction or division

explanation.surface: Someone taking control ahead of a parliamentary vote.
explanation.walkthrough: A division is a vote in Parliament, the misleading sense here.
explanation.definitionFit: To chair or be in authority over a meeting is to preside.

clue.text: Counter-revolutionary's defeat

indicators.note: revolutionary suggests the letters of the word counter are turned upside down and rearranged

explanation.surface: The overthrow of a reactionary rebel.
explanation.definitionFit: To trounce someone is to beat them soundly.

clue.text: Out of play or he'll press his claim

parts.note: ex is a Latin prefix meaning out of
an act is part of a stage play

explanation.surface: A threat from someone who will press his claim unless he is dealt in.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who demands payment insistently is a demander.

clue.text: Fitting a ring into supports

indicators.note: the ring letter is put into the word for supports

parts.note: props are supports
O looks like a ring

explanation.surface: Fitting a ring onto a set of supports.
explanation.definitionFit: Apropos means appropriate or opportune.

clue.text: Adjust dress, then readjust

parts.note: to rig out is to dress

indicators.note: readjust tells us the letters of then are set in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Instructions to straighten one's clothing and then do it again.
explanation.definitionFit: To straighten or put right is to set something correctly.

clue.text: The trade tariff is to be changed, note

indicators.note: the letters of tariff are to be altered into a new order

parts.note: C is a musical note

explanation.surface: A notice that customs duties will alter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be changed' rearranges TARIFF to TRAFFI.
explanation.definitionFit: Traffic means dealings or commerce, especially illicit trade.

clue.text: Attempts to finish crate when there's port

parts.note: tries are attempts

indicators.note: only the finishing letters of crate are kept, the rest dropped

explanation.surface: Someone attempts to finish packing a crate at a harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finish' keeps just TE, the end of crate.
explanation.definitionFit: Trieste is an Italian seaport on the Adriatic.

clue.text: Speedily grabbing a number is quite right!

indicators.note: the speed word grabs the number and the next word, holding them inside

parts.note: fast means speedily
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: Someone eagerly agreeing that grabbing a number quickly is correct.
explanation.walkthrough: Quite right is read as very far right politically.
explanation.definitionFit: A fascist holds extreme right-wing views.

clue.text: Far from well done — so unusual

explanation.surface: Observing that undercooked meat is uncommon.
explanation.definitionFit: A bloody steak is barely cooked, and scarce things are uncommon.

clue.text: On the other hand it could make a profit

parts.note: a gain is a profit

explanation.surface: A remark that something might be profitable after all.
explanation.definitionFit: Again can mean moreover or besides, introducing a contrasting point.

clue.text: Continent is backed in a couple of articles

indicators.note: the reversed word goes in the pair of article letters

parts.note: A is the indefinite article, and two of them give a pair

indicators.note: backed means read backwards, so the little word is is turned round

explanation.surface: A remark that a continent is supported in a pair of essays.
explanation.definitionFit: Asia is the largest of the world's land masses.

clue.text: An African taking up space

indicators.note: in a down clue taking up means the word for space reads upwards

parts.note: room is space

explanation.surface: An African person occupying a lot of room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking up' reverses ROOM in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A Moor is a person of the Muslim peoples of north-west Africa.

clue.text: Lady, so it's made out

indicators.note: out signals the letters of made are put out of order

explanation.surface: Someone working out that a woman is so.
explanation.definitionFit: A dame is a woman, or a title for a woman knighted.

clue.text: Ensure the utmost advantage from this enterprise

definitions.meaning: to make full use of something, verb
a bold feat or adventure, noun

explanation.surface: Advice to get the most out of a venture.
explanation.definitionFit: To milk a situation is to use it fully, and a daring feat is a deed of this kind.

clue.text: Resort to telephone to effect saving

parts.note: a spa is a health resort
to ring is to phone

explanation.surface: Turning to the phone to save money.
explanation.definitionFit: Sparing means economical or frugal.

clue.text: Get mean-stern-awkward, causing some disaffection

indicators.note: awkward means the letters of get, mean and stern are arranged clumsily into a new order

explanation.surface: Getting unpleasant and harsh, which alienates people.
explanation.definitionFit: Estrangement is alienation or the loss of affection between people.
